text: Sho? was a Dubai-based band that blended rock, alternative, punk, and electronica, composed of expatriates and active in the Dubai rock music scene for approximately eighteen months. The band released one Internet-only single, "Crash," in April 2010, and one EP, I Don't Wanna Go, in August 2010. Their name was derived from a version of the Arabic word "Sho," which translates roughly to "What." The group was formed in June 2009 by Zara Quiroga and Rizal Khan, who met through an online music forum. Other members who served brief stints included Eric Quay Evano, Fabrizio 'Fab' Benefazio, Justin Blincoe, Karim El Gamal, and Branislav 'Bane' Trkulja. Zara Quiroga, the only female member and lead vocalist, was of Portuguese and Spanish descent and had undergone several years of vocal training; she had previously performed as a vocalist on Hugo Flores' 2006 album Project Creation – Dawn On Pyther. Rizal Khan, born in Malaysia, was the lead guitarist and had previously played with the Malaysian bands Dust Components (1995–1997), Burial Ground (1997–1999), and Morphed Assembly (2000). Sho? performed regularly at events in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, such as Metal Asylum, Black Sheep, Rock Nation, and Yasalam Beats on the Beach. In 2009, they won the Road to Sound City competition, judged by Gary Dourdan, Kim Thompson, and representatives from Diesel, Sennheiser, and EMI Arabia, which granted them a main stage performance at the Dubai Sound City festival and participation in the Diesel U-Music World Tour, including a performance in Vienna, Austria in November 2009. Articles about Sho? were published in UAE media outlets including the Khaleej Times, The National, 7 Days, Gulf News, and Rolling Stone Middle East. In February 2010, the band was shortlisted by Dubai's Time Out magazine for the "Best Local Band" category, attending the awards ceremony at the Atlantis Hotel. On 5 April 2010, they were featured on the Dubai One TV show Twenty Something. The single "Crash" also appeared on the compilation CD UAE Metal Asylum (July 2010). The EP I Don't Wanna Go contains four tracks: "Sho?", "Crash," "P(h)ride," and "Winter." The band officially announced their dissolution in January 2011.
